one_line_description: Onshore US manufacturer of rare earth magnets for aerospace, defense and critical technologies (Durham/Benson, NC).
justification: Sells a strategic input to defense and industrial buyers backed by Pentagon contracts and ~$1B in government-linked financing for a new factory; strong demand pull from China supply-chain risk, but very capital-intensive with manufacturing-level margins.

one_line_description: AI collateral-underwriting platform (MIRA) that automates appraisal review for mortgage lenders.
justification: B2B SaaS embedded in lender workflows (claims 80% faster review, 2M+ loans processed) gives sticky, usage-linked recurring revenue; revenue is exposed to cyclical mortgage origination volume.

one_line_description: Integrated governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform automating SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/NIST compliance and vendor risk.
justification: Subscription B2B SaaS with high switching costs once controls and evidence live in the platform; $12M Series A (2025) but competes in a crowded category (Vanta, Drata, OneTrust).

one_line_description: Open-standard AI networking stack (scale-up switching silicon/systems + network OS) for AI data centers.
justification: High-ASP hardware plus software sold into the fastest-growing capex category; $500M+ raised at ~$2B valuation with Nvidia backing, but capital-intensive and up against Broadcom, Nvidia and Cisco.

one_line_description: Dental workforce platform connecting practices/DSOs with on-demand and permanent dental staff, now adding an AI recruiting agent (Mel).
justification: Two-sided staffing marketplace earns a take rate on shifts/placements; network effects and a move toward SaaS for DSOs help, but staffing margins are thin and supply acquisition is costly.

one_line_description: Pediatric and young-adult mental health clinic delivering in-network therapy and psychiatry via telehealth and in-person clinics.
justification: Insurance-reimbursed care with strong demand (mental health is the top-funded digital health area), but it employs its clinicians, so revenue scales roughly linearly with headcount at services-level margins.

one_line_description: Secondary marketplace where real estate operators sell lease cash flows to institutional investors (YC W24).
justification: Transaction-fee marketplace addressing a large ($1.5T/yr US lease) market with a novel asset class; still early with the classic two-sided liquidity problem to solve.

one_line_description: AI agent ('Worky') that sources, negotiates and manages hotel room blocks for corporate offsites and group travel.
justification: Asset-light, free-to-start/pay-on-booking model with good logos (Ramp, Block, SeatGeek); revenue is episodic per event and ticket sizes are modest, limiting recurring revenue.

one_line_description: NJ advanced electronic materials company making patented ZTACH ACE conductive adhesives, conductive inks and encapsulants for electronics packaging.
justification: Patent-protected specialty materials can earn good gross margins, but long design-in cycles and a niche market explain slow growth (~16 staff after 14 years).

one_line_description: Bio-based, compostable PBS polymer and yarn positioned as a drop-in replacement for polyester in apparel.
justification: Strategic brand backing (H&M Group, Bestseller, Inditex pilots) but pre-scale; must reach cost parity with commodity polyester and needs large manufacturing capex before revenue scales.

one_line_description: IoT 'smart label' platform that tracks real-world product consumption for CPG brands and triggers auto-replenishment.
justification: Hardware-per-unit plus data platform model has pilots with Clorox, Colgate and Tyson, but after ~10 years and ~$3.6M raised it remains ~12 people, suggesting slow enterprise adoption and unit-cost friction.

one_line_description: Jersey City biotech developing adenosine-based regenerative therapies to regrow cartilage in osteoarthritis (NYU spinout).
justification: Pre-revenue therapeutic with a binary, long, capital-intensive regulatory path; the model is essentially a future licensing or acquisition, with a large prize if the drug works.
